name: Brainclaw
description: Self-evolving multi-agent episodic memory. Records experiences, updates Q-values, synthesizes behavioral guidelines, and shares hints across agents via A2A.

enabled.label: Enable Brainclaw
enabled.help: Globally enable or pause Brainclaw memory learning.

sidecarUrl.label: Brainclaw Sidecar URL
sidecarUrl.help: HTTP URL of the Brainclaw sidecar service.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: Unique identifier for this agent in Brainclaw's memory.

learnMode.label: Learn Mode
learnMode.help: all=learn every turn, tools_only=only tool-use turns, balanced=prefer tool turns.

recordEnabled.label: Enable Experience Recording
recordEnabled.help: Record agent actions as episodic memories.

injectGuidelines.label: Inject Guidelines into Prompt
injectGuidelines.help: Prepend learned guidelines to system prompt.
